newsitem.title: USA: Mexicans, feminists, mythical monster take on IMF.
newsitem.headline: Mexicans, feminists, mythical monster take on IMF.

text.p: Mexican debtors, feminists and environmental activists joined forces on Sunday with a mythical Central American monster to protest IMF policies.
Waving signs and giant puppets, some 50 protesters marched from the White House to the headquarters of the International Monetary Fund to scorn its policies on women and the poor.
Among the demonstrators were five militants from a Mexican debtors movement on a three-day hunger strike during the IMF's annual gathering of the world's financial policy-makers.
A young woman in leotards wore a mask with huge fangs representing "Chupacabras", a fabled Central American monster reputed to suck the life out of barnyard animals.
"I used to feast on goats but I've decided to help the debtors. I'm going gobble up the bankers and bureaucrats of the IMF and the World Bank!" she growled.
Another hunger striker said they were protesting against Mexico's IMF-inspired austerity measures. Mexican debtors were severely stung by last year's peso crisis.
